note.kid: Everyone on your street shares the same fibre, so each house only opens envelopes with its own number.
note.nerd: Downstream is broadcast to every ONT on the splitter and AES-encrypted per GEM port; upstream uses time slots.

pli.name: Payload length
pli.about: Bytes of payload in this GEM frame.

port.about: Everyone on the splitter hears every frame going down; each ONT only keeps its own Port-IDs.

pti.name: Payload type
pti.about: User data, and whether this is the last fragment.
